correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the complete edge list d_a,d_b,p_i,q_i,r_i for the three-part graph and all disjoint edge-pair 2-cells: c2=3t²−t. The oriented cubical boundary ∂(e∧f)=(f,y)−(f,x)−(e,u)+(e,z) makes partner coefficients around fixed g a signed circulation in the graph with g endpoints deleted. For g=d_a,d_b the partner star forces A_i=C_i=0. For p_i, q_j and r_j, all remaining equations are exactly R_ij=−P_ij, T_ij=P_ij, P_ij=P_ji, P_ii=0 and each row sum zero, with no division. As C3=0, these integer kernel coordinates give full H2 with no saturation ambiguity. Under swap a↔b the explicit cellular cycle z(P) changes sign, while permutations of W act by unsigned incidence coordinates. B_t has rational rank t for t≥3, so rank C(t,2)−t=t(t−3)/2. A vertex cover {v,a,b} of size three meets each graph edge and every simple cycle uses ≥2 cover vertices, excluding disjoint cycles. Independently constructed signed cubical boundary ranks at t=3,4,5,6 were 24/42/65/93 with kernel dimensions 0/2/5/9; a t=4 alternating quadrilateral matrix gave explicit integral zero-boundary cycle. The finite rank examples corroborate the universal signed incidence solution.

value.rationale: An exact integral symmetry-module classification over an unbounded natural nonplanar complete-tripartite family supplies structural information beyond a Betti-number formula. Its explicit signed cellular cycle basis coordinates and proof that no vertex-disjoint-cycle product torus exists give a concrete uniform non-toric model relevant to geometric generation questions in graph configuration topology. The rank and existence of some non-toric classes are known prior facts, but they do not remove the separate value of this complete equivariant lattice.
residual_risks: The family is sparse among all complete tripartite graphs, but its high symmetry and sharp non-toric geometric mechanism motivate the fixed-part specialization.

No two disjoint graph cycles exist, so no generators are product tori from pairs of disjoint simple cycles.
